name: 会話のプレビュー行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE actual Lighthouse LH03-0038「会話のプレビュー行」.
Image1 ORIGINAL controls avatar glyph silhouette, optical proportions, unread state, timestamp/badge and fine details. Image2 Japanese mock is secondary for exact localized copy and native typography/logical390x88. Image3 approved white/forest-green/slate style only.
Recreate ONE plain WHITE conversation list row, no surrounding added card. At left52px WHITE circular avatar with fine neutral outline. Restore ORIGINAL filled generic-person silhouette: small oval head and smooth rounded shoulder bust, exact source proportions, coherent slate#526173. Do not copy mock's mint circle or initial「山」; source generic-person icon is primary.
Text column begins x84 logical: exact name「山田 はるか」Meiryo Bold14px/24px, tracking0, dark#1D1D1D; beneath exact latest message「昨日はありがとうございました。」Meiryo Regular12px/16px, tracking0, quietgray#6E6E6E, single line. At upper right exact「12:43」Meiryo Regular12px/16px in forestgreen#1F6444, matching actual unread state. Below it at far right a20px forestgreen circular UNREAD badge with exact white「1」Meiryo Bold12px/16px. Source has no tick, pin or online dot on THIS row; add none. Preserve name/message/time/count and source alignment.
One fine neutral bottom divider begins under text column and runs to right edge, as source/native. Keep source row compactness and generous avatar/text separation, uniform scale from390x88. White#FFFFFF outercanvas and row; no mint fill, new shadows/card or selected-row tint.
Accent evidence: source green time and badge indicate one unread message; retain that coherent meaning in forestgreen, badge1 visible as well as color. Original cyan avatar fill is decorative default identity; omit fill tint and use slate original silhouette on white. No forced primary button.
ONE complete shortwide component centered prominently on landscape with modest margins and no clipping. No list neighbors, Chats heading/search/filters/footer/phone, new values or controls. Static raster candidate; no message-read/navigation claim.
reviewNotes: 原画像を既定人物の塗り輪郭・未読1/緑時刻・整列の主参照、モックを山田 はるか/昨日はありがとうございました。と14/12役割の副参照。出力を目視し全文/句点・12:43/未読1・原画像の人物形・白アバター/面・本文下からの細い区切り・余計なピン/チェック/在席点なしを確認。意味のある未読の時刻/件数だけ森林緑、装飾シアン/ミントを省略。厳密字体/記号計測・実未読/遷移・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
